hints.title: N-ary Children First Traversal
hints.text: Visit and exhaust all descendant subtrees from left to right prior to recording the current parent node valuation.

hints.title: Recursive Post-Order Collection
hints.text: For each child in node children, recursively execute postorder traversal, then append current node val to the collected list.

hints.title: Postorder Blueprint
hints.text: Define res = []. Helper dfs(node): if not node: return. For child in node.children: dfs(child). res.append(node.val). Return res after calling dfs(root).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total nodes in n-ary tree
complexity.notes: Visits every node once with call stack depth bounded by tree height.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recording values before traversing subtrees produces preorder sequence instead of postorder.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear time with tree depth auxiliary stack space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct bottom-up evaluation visiting all children before parent.
